active.description: Default profile name to use when no --profile or SKILL_PROFILE is set

adb_path.description: Path to adb binary (default: 'adb', resolved from PATH)

adb_host.description: ADB server host (default: not set, uses local adb server). Useful for WSL connecting to Windows ADB server via 127.0.0.1

serial.description: Device serial or IP:port for WiFi ADB (e.g. 192.168.1.100:5555)
